ex.en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天第一次上游泳课前，我感到很紧张。

ex.en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
ex.zh: 对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。

tip: nervous about后接名词或动名词，表示对某事紧张。

senses.en: emotions such as happiness, sadness, anger, or excitement

ex.en: It is healthy to share your feelings with your parents.
ex.zh: 和父母分享你的情感是健康的做法。

ex.en: Poets often write short poems to express their deep feelings about nature and family.
ex.zh: 诗人常常写短诗来表达他们对自然和家庭的深厚情感。

col: share your feelings｜分享你的情感
hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: 表示“感情；情绪”时，feeling通常以复数形式feelings出现。

ex.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。

ex.en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。

tip: 生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

ex.en: Leah expressed her thanks with a warm smile.
ex.zh: 莉娅用一个温暖的微笑表达了谢意。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to express their opinions on decisions that affect their education.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会对影响其教育的决策发表意见。

tip: express作动词直接接宾语，如express your views。

senses.en: a school or public event where people perform skills like singing or dancing

ex.en: Amy will play the piano at our school talent show.
ex.zh: 艾米将在我们学校的才艺表演上弹钢琴。

ex.en: Students practiced singing, dancing, and magic tricks for the big yearly talent show.
ex.zh: 学生们为一年一度的大型才艺表演练习唱歌、跳舞和魔术。

col: a school talent show｜学校才艺表演
join the talent show｜参加才艺表演
win the talent show｜赢得才艺表演
tip: talent意为“才能；天赋”，show指“演出”，合起来是“才艺表演”。

ex.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。

ex.en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
ex.zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

col: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气
out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

ex.en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
ex.zh: 你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。

ex.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
ex.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

ex.en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
ex.zh: 我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。

ex.en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。

col: something is wrong with｜……出了问题
tip: go wrong表示出问题；wrong的词首w不发音。

senses.en: a large outdoor park with exciting rides, games, and shows for fun

ex.en: We had great fun riding the Ferris wheel at the amusement park.
ex.zh: 我们在游乐场坐摩天轮玩得很开心。

ex.en: During the summer holiday, many families visit the amusement park to enjoy water rides together.
ex.zh: 暑假期间，许多家庭去游乐场一起体验水上娱乐设施。

col: visit an amusement park｜去游乐场玩
rides at the amusement park｜游乐场的游乐设施
a big amusement park｜大游乐场
tip: amusement以元音音素开头，表达“一个游乐场”要用an。

senses.en: a large indoor building with many different shops, restaurants, and cinemas

ex.en: Let's meet at the new shopping mall near the subway station.
ex.zh: 我们在地铁站附近的新购物商场见面吧。

ex.en: On rainy weekends, people like to walk around the shopping mall and eat delicious snacks.
ex.zh: 在下雨的周末，人们喜欢在购物商场里逛逛，吃些美味的小吃。

col: go to the shopping mall｜去购物商场
a large shopping mall｜大型购物商场
meet at the shopping mall｜在商场见面
tip: 注意mall读作/mɔːl/，不要与small（小的）或hall（大厅）混淆。

senses.en: a large building or area where people can play many different sports

ex.en: My cousin plays badminton at the sports centre every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我表哥每周日都在体育中心打羽毛球。

ex.en: Our neighborhood built a modern sports centre with a swimming pool and a basketball court.
ex.zh: 我们社区建了一座现代化的体育中心，里面有游泳池和篮球场。

col: at the sports centre｜在体育中心
a community sports centre｜社区体育中心
visit the sports centre｜去体育中心
tip: centre是英式拼写，美式常写作center；前面sports要用复数。

ex.en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。

ex.en: Public libraries support lifelong learning by providing free access to books, digital resources, and quiet study spaces.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供书籍、数字资源和安静的学习空间来支持终身学习。

tip: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

ex.en: Museums can help young people understand local history by connecting everyday objects with the lives of previous generations.
ex.zh: 博物馆可以将日常物品与前人的生活联系起来，帮助年轻人了解当地历史。

col: natural history museum｜自然历史博物馆
tip: museum是可数名词；参观博物馆说visit a museum。

ex.en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
ex.zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。

ex.en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。

tip: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

ex.en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
ex.zh: 我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。

ex.en: Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
ex.zh: 价格亲民的周末活动能鼓励家人在当地社区共度更多时光。

col: a long weekend｜连休的长周末
tip: 英式常说 at the weekend，美式常用 on。

ex.en: Our guide explained the history of the old castle.
ex.zh: 导游讲述了这座古堡的历史。

ex.en: Studying history helps citizens understand how past decisions continue to shape modern societies and institutions.
ex.zh: 学习历史有助于公民理解过去的决策如何持续塑造现代社会及其制度。

tip: historical指与历史有关；historic指有历史意义。

senses.en: controlled by a computer or technology so it can work automatically

ex.en: We have a smart speaker that plays music by voice.
ex.zh: 我们有一个能通过语音播放音乐的智能音箱。

ex.en: In a smart home, lights and air conditioners can turn on and off by themselves.
ex.zh: 在智能家居里，电灯和空调可以自动开关。

tip: smart除了形容人“聪明的”，在科技语境下常指“智能的”。

ex.en: Can you drive me to the station after breakfast?
ex.zh: 早饭后你能开车送我去车站吗？

ex.en: Consumer demand can drive innovation by encouraging companies to develop products that use fewer natural resources.
ex.zh: 消费者需求可以鼓励企业开发消耗更少自然资源的产品，从而推动创新。

col: drive economic growth｜推动经济增长
go for a drive｜开车兜风
tip: 不规则变化：drive—drove—driven；送某人用drive sb to。

ex.en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
ex.zh: 如果我没接到你的电话，请留言。

ex.en: Public health campaigns need a clear message that people from different backgrounds can easily understand.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传需要传达清晰的信息，让不同背景的人都能轻松理解。

col: get the message across｜把意思传达清楚
tip: message是可数名词；information通常不可数。

ex.en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
ex.zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。

ex.en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
ex.zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。

tip: be crowded with 表示“挤满……”。

senses.en: a small telephone that you can carry around with you anywhere

ex.en: My mother uses her mobile phone to call Grandma every evening.
ex.zh: 我妈妈每天晚上都用手机给奶奶打电话。

ex.en: Students should not bring a mobile phone into the classroom during school hours.
ex.zh: 学生在上课期间不应该把手机带进教室。

col: answer a mobile phone｜接手机电话
turn off your mobile phone｜关掉你的手机
tip: mobile意为“可移动的”，指随身携带的电话；也可简称phone。

ex.en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
ex.zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间骑车游玩。

ex.en: Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 乡村地区可靠的公共交通可以改善就业机会的可及性，并减少农村居民对汽车的依赖。

col: protect the countryside｜保护乡村环境
tip: 通常不可数，常说the countryside，不说a countryside。

ex.en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。

tip: the whole village可指全村居民，而非建筑。

senses.en: to take ripe fruit off trees or bushes with your hands

ex.en: We love to pick fruit on Uncle Bob's farm in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天我们喜欢在鲍勃叔叔的农场里摘水果。

ex.en: Last weekend, our class visited an orchard to pick fruit and learn about farm plants.
ex.zh: 上周末，我们班去果园摘水果，并了解了农场的植物。

col: go to pick fruit｜去摘水果
tip: fruit作水果总称时通常为不可数名词，pick fruit后不加s。

senses.en: to give food to pets or farm animals

ex.en: Little children enjoy helping the farmer feed animals on weekends.
ex.zh: 小朋友们周末喜欢帮农民伯伯喂动物。

ex.en: In the zoo, visitors must follow the signs and never feed animals with snacks.
ex.zh: 在动物园里，游客必须遵守指示牌，绝对不能用零食喂动物。

tip: feed表示“喂养”，过去式是fed，常与with或on搭配使用。

senses.en: to go to a river or lake to try to catch fish

ex.en: My grandpa and I often go fishing by the quiet lake.
ex.zh: 我和爷爷经常去安静的湖边钓鱼。

ex.en: On sunny Saturday mornings, some villagers go fishing along the river to relax.
ex.zh: 在晴朗的周六早上，一些村民会去河边钓鱼放松一下。

col: love to go fishing｜喜欢去钓鱼
go fishing by the river｜去河边钓鱼
tip: “go+动词-ing”表示去做某项户外活动，如go swimming去游泳。

senses.en: to gather fresh eggs laid by hens in a coop or basket

ex.en: Every morning, Sarah goes to the hen house to collect eggs.
ex.zh: 每天早上，萨拉都去鸡舍捡鸡蛋。

ex.en: When we stayed in the countryside, our favorite morning chore was to collect eggs from the barn.
ex.zh: 在乡下住的时候，我们最喜欢的早晨家务就是去谷仓捡鸡蛋。

col: collect eggs in a basket｜用篮子捡鸡蛋
tip: collect意为“收集；采集”，egg是可数名词，捡鸡蛋常加s。

ex.en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my sister.
ex.zh: 我剥了一个橙子，和妹妹分着吃。

ex.en: An orange provides vitamin C, but a balanced diet requires a variety of foods.
ex.zh: 橙子能提供维生素C，但均衡饮食需要多种食物。

tip: 橙子可数；表示橙色时通常不可数。

senses.en: the quiet and natural way of living in the countryside

ex.en: My grandparents love peaceful country life with fresh air.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母喜欢空气清新的宁静乡村生活。

ex.en: Compared with busy city streets, country life gives people more time to enjoy nature.
ex.zh: 与繁忙的城市街道相比，乡村生活让人们有更多时间亲近自然。

col: enjoy country life｜享受乡村生活
quiet country life｜安静的乡村生活
city life and country life｜城市生活与乡村生活
tip: country此处指“乡村”，不是“国家”；country life意为乡村生活。

ex.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
ex.zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。

ex.en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。

tip: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

senses.en: To move a small boat across water using two wooden oars.

ex.en: My father and I row a boat on the lake.
ex.zh: 我和爸爸在湖上划船。

ex.en: In sunny spring, many families go to the city park and row a boat together.
ex.zh: 在阳光明媚的春天，许多家庭去城市公园里一起划船。

col: row a boat slowly｜慢慢划船
row a boat on the lake｜在湖上划船
learn to row a boat｜学划船
tip: row作动词表示“划（船）”，读作/rəʊ/，注意和“一排”同形同音。

senses.en: things that a person, animal, or plant must have in order to live well

ex.en: Food, water, and sleep are basic needs for every child.
ex.zh: 食物、水和睡眠是每个孩子的基本需求。

ex.en: In science class, we discussed the basic needs of plants, such as sunlight and water.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们讨论了植物的基本需求，比如阳光和水。

col: meet people's needs｜满足人们的需求
tip: need作名词表“需求”时常用复数needs，如basic needs。

senses.en: things that you would like to have, even if you do not really need them

ex.en: We should buy what we need before spending money on our wants.
ex.zh: 我们在花钱买想要的东西之前，应该先买必需品。

ex.en: In our life skills class, the teacher explained the difference between basic needs and daily wants.
ex.zh: 在生活技能课上，老师解释了基本需求和日常想要的东西之间的区别。

col: needs and wants｜必需品和想要的东西
list your wants｜列出想要的东西
tip: 这里作复数名词，常与 needs（必需品）搭配对比使用。

ex.en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我需要在吃早饭前买些面包。

ex.en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
ex.zh: 消费者在当地市场购买新鲜农产品时，可以减少包装废弃物。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bought；不要写成buyed。

senses.en: to keep money instead of spending it so you can use it later

ex.en: I save five yuan every week in my little pink piggy bank.
ex.zh: 我每周都在我的粉色小猪存钱罐里存五元钱。

ex.en: Children can learn good money habits when they save part of their pocket money each month.
ex.zh: 当孩子们每个月把部分零花钱存起来时，就能养成良好的理财习惯。

col: save for a bike｜攒钱买自行车
save in a bank｜把钱存进银行
tip: 本课指“储蓄；存钱”，过去式直接加 d 变成 saved。

senses.en: extra money that a bank pays you when you keep your money there

ex.en: Put your money in the bank and you will earn some interest.
ex.zh: 把你的钱存进银行，你就会赚到一些利息。

ex.en: During our maths project, we learned how a savings account grows slowly by earning bank interest.
ex.zh: 在数学课题活动中，我们学习了储蓄账户如何通过赚取银行利息慢慢增长。

tip: 此处指金融“利息”，作不可数名词，不能加 s 变复数。

ex.en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
ex.zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
ex.zh: 小企业越来越多地在线销售产品，以吸引本地社区以外的顾客。

col: sell something to someone｜把某物卖给某人
sell an idea｜推销一个想法
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sold；sell well常用主动形式。

senses.en: the worldwide computer network that connects millions of devices and shares information

ex.en: My father often uses the Internet to check the weather before driving.
ex.zh: 我爸爸开车前经常用互联网查看天气。

ex.en: Students in our science club search for space photos on the Internet during computer lessons.
ex.zh: 我们科学社团的学生在电脑课上通过互联网搜索太空照片。

col: connect to the Internet｜连接互联网
tip: 表示“互联网”时前面通常加定冠词 the，首字母常大写。

senses.en: to write a message on a computer or phone and deliver it online

ex.en: Please send an email to your uncle to thank him for the gift.
ex.zh: 请给你叔叔发一封邮件，感谢他送的礼物。

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to send an email with our nature reports before Friday afternoon.
ex.zh: 老师让我们在周五下午前发一封附上自然报告的邮件。

col: send an email to｜给……发邮件
send an email quickly｜快速发邮件
check and send an email｜检查并发送邮件
tip: email 以元音音素开头，所以前面要用不定冠词 an。

ex.en: Download the map before you leave the hotel tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天离开酒店前，先把地图下载好。

ex.en: Students can download course materials at home, allowing them to study even when internet access is unavailable.
ex.zh: 学生可以在家下载课程资料，这样即使无法联网也能学习。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；反义词是upload。

senses.en: an online storage space where you can save and share files over the Internet

ex.en: I save all our happy family photos in my cloud drive safely.
ex.zh: 我把所有快乐的家庭照片都安全地存在云盘里。

ex.en: Our science group uses a shared cloud drive to store videos and slides for class.
ex.zh: 我们科学小组用共享云盘保存课堂所需的视频和幻灯片。

col: save to a cloud drive｜存到云盘
share via cloud drive｜通过云盘分享
tip: cloud 指网络“云端”，drive 在这里表示“存储驱动器”。

ex.en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
ex.zh: 我把我们野餐的照片上传到了共享文件夹。

ex.en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
ex.zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。

col: upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

senses.en: a school lesson that students attend using a computer or tablet over the Internet

ex.en: I turn on my tablet at nine o'clock for my English online class.
ex.zh: 我九点钟打开平板电脑上我的英语网课。

ex.en: During the typhoon day, students stayed safe at home and joined their online class together.
ex.zh: 台风天期间，同学们安全待在家里，一起参加网课学习。

col: join an online class｜加入网课
have an online class｜上一节网课
tip: 表示“上网课”常搭配动词 take 或 have，如 take an online class。

ex.en: We watched the sun rise over the ocean.
ex.zh: 我们看着太阳从海面上升起。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生动物，并最终可能通过食物链影响人类健康。

tip: ocean通常比sea范围大；专名常加the。

ex.en: We bought fresh seafood at the harbour this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们在港口买了新鲜海鲜。

ex.en: Demand for sustainable seafood has encouraged some fishing communities to adopt methods that cause less damage to marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对可持续海产品的需求促使一些渔业社区采用对海洋生态系统破坏较小的捕捞方式。

tip: 通常是不可数名词；一盘海鲜可说a plate of seafood。

ex.en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
ex.zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。

ex.en: Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.
ex.zh: 减少对石油的依赖，需要持续投资于可再生能源和更高效的公共交通。

col: oil a hinge｜给铰链加润滑油
tip: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

senses.en: a clean-burning gas found underground that people use for cooking and heating

ex.en: My mother cooks dinner every evening using safe natural gas in our kitchen.
ex.zh: 我妈妈每天晚上都在厨房里用安全的天然气做晚饭。

ex.en: In geography class, we learned that natural gas is an important energy source under the ground.
ex.zh: 在地理课上，我们了解到天然气是地下一种重要的能源。

tip: natural gas 是不可数名词短语，前面不用加 a 或 an。

senses.en: clean electricity made from the daily rise and fall of ocean water

ex.en: People living near the sea can use tidal energy to make electricity.
ex.zh: 住在海边的人们可以利用潮汐能来发电。

ex.en: In science class, we watched a video about how tidal energy powers coastal towns cleanly.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们看了一个关于潮汐能如何清洁地为沿海城镇供电的视频。

col: clean tidal energy｜清洁的潮汐能
tip: tidal 来自名词 tide（潮汐），表示“潮汐的”，是不可数名词词组。

ex.en: We spent the afternoon building sandcastles at the seaside.
ex.zh: 我们下午在海边堆沙堡。

ex.en: Seaside towns often depend on summer tourism, which can create unstable employment for local residents.
ex.zh: 海滨小镇往往依赖夏季旅游业，这可能使当地居民的就业不稳定。

tip: 名词常用 the seaside；表示“在海边”用 at。

ex.en: We watched a film about stars and the universe.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于恒星和宇宙的电影。

ex.en: Research into the origins of the universe has driven advances in telescope technology and data analysis.
ex.zh: 对宇宙起源的研究推动了望远镜技术和数据分析的进步。

col: the expanding universe｜不断膨胀的宇宙
the origins of the universe｜宇宙的起源
tip: 指宇宙通常用the universe；开头是辅音音素/j/。

ex.en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。

col: a rising star｜冉冉升起的新星
star in a film｜主演电影
tip: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

senses.en: the planet that we live on, with land, oceans, and air

ex.en: We must plant more green trees to protect the earth around us.
ex.zh: 我们必须多种绿色树木来保护我们身边的地球。

ex.en: In our science lesson, we learned that the earth travels around the sun every year.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们学到地球每年都会绕着太阳运转一圈。

col: care for the earth｜爱护地球
tip: 表示独一无二的天体“地球”时，前面要加 the，读作 /ði/。

senses.en: the bright round object that moves around the earth and shines at night

ex.en: Look up at the sky and see the moon shining brightly tonight.
ex.zh: 抬头看看天空，今晚的月球正明亮地闪耀着。

ex.en: Chinese astronauts and space probes have sent back clear pictures from the moon for study.
ex.zh: 中国的航天员和太空探测器从月球发回了清晰的图像供研究。

tip: moon 是世界上独一无二的天体，因此前面通常加定冠词 the。

senses.en: the fourth planet from the sun, known for its reddish rock and dust

ex.en: Mars looks like a bright red star in the clear night sky.
ex.zh: 在晴朗的夜空中，火星看起来像一颗明亮的红星。

ex.en: Scientists sent a small robot rover to Mars to take photos and study red rocks.
ex.zh: 科学家们向火星发射了一辆小型探测车，用来拍照并研究红色岩石。

tip: Mars 是专有名词，首字母必须大写，且前面不加定冠词 the。

ex.en: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们用望远镜观察了一颗明亮的行星。

ex.en: Scientists study distant planets to understand whether conditions suitable for life exist beyond Earth.
ex.zh: 科学家研究遥远的行星，以了解地球以外是否存在适合生命的条件。

tip: planet是行星，star是恒星；the planet常指地球。

ex.en: Wipe the kitchen surface before you start preparing lunch.
ex.zh: 开始准备午饭前，先擦一下厨房台面。

ex.en: Dark road surfaces absorb heat during the day, contributing to higher temperatures in urban areas.
ex.zh: 深色路面白天吸收热量，导致城市地区气温升高。

tip: on the surface 指“在表面上”，也可指“表面看来”。

ex.en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
ex.zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

ex.en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
ex.zh: 你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。

ex.en: Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
ex.zh: 人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。

tip: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。

ex.en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
ex.zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

tip: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

ex.en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
ex.zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。

ex.en: Protecting beautiful natural landscapes can attract visitors while preserving valuable habitats for future generations.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的自然景观既能吸引游客，又能为后代保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 可修饰景色、声音等；比较级用more beautiful。

ex.en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。

ex.en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。

tip: 表示极好或令人愉快，不等于奇怪的。

senses.en: a public holiday on May 1st to celebrate and thank working people

ex.en: My family will visit a nice park together during the Labour Day holiday.
ex.zh: 五一劳动节假期期间，我们一家人将一起去逛一个漂亮的公园。

ex.en: Before Labour Day, our school held an activity to thank cleaners and security guards warmly.
ex.zh: 劳动节前夕，我们学校举办了活动，热烈感谢保洁员和保安叔叔。

tip: 节日名称两个单词首字母都要大写；美式拼写常作 Labor Day。

senses.en: a special holiday on June 1st in China to celebrate children

ex.en: We sing happy songs and play games on Children's Day.
ex.zh: 我们在儿童节那天唱快乐的歌、做游戏。

ex.en: On Children's Day, our school holds a wonderful party with magic shows and sweet snacks.
ex.zh: 在儿童节那天，我们学校会举办一场有魔术表演和美味零食的精彩派对。

tip: 节日名称两个词首字母都要大写，children's后加's表所有格。

senses.en: to hold a special big party or show with music, games, and performances

ex.en: Our town will have a gala with music and lanterns next Saturday.
ex.zh: 下周六我们镇上将举行一场有音乐和灯笼的庆典。

ex.en: Every December, students at our school have a gala in the hall to welcome New Year.
ex.zh: 每年十二月，我们学校的学生都会在礼堂举行庆典来迎接新年。

col: have a gala tonight｜今晚举行庆典
have a Spring Festival gala｜举办春节联欢会
have a school gala｜举行校园庆典
tip: gala 表示“盛会；联欢会”，have a gala 意为举行庆典。

senses.en: to take a long walk in the hills, woods, or countryside for fun

ex.en: My dad and I often go hiking in the hills on sunny Sundays.
ex.zh: 我和爸爸经常在晴朗的周日去山里徒步。

ex.en: Our class plans to go hiking along the green mountain trail during the autumn trip.
ex.zh: 我们班计划在秋游时沿着绿意盎然的山间小径去徒步。

col: go hiking in the mountains｜去山里徒步
love to go hiking｜喜欢去徒步
tip: go + 动词 -ing 表示“去做某项户外活动”，注意 hike 去 e 加 ing。

senses.en: to go out for a short pleasure trip to a park or nature area

ex.en: Let's pack some fruit and sandwiches and go on an outing tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们带些水果和三明治，明天一起去郊游吧。

ex.en: Every spring, our grade teachers take us to go on an outing in Lotus Hill Park.
ex.zh: 每年春天，我们年级的老师都会带我们去莲花山公园郊游。

col: go on an outing together｜一起去郊游
go on a spring outing｜去春游
plan to go on an outing｜计划去郊游
tip: outing 以元音音素开头，前面用 an；也可在中间加 spring 表春游。

senses.en: a cheerful autumn celebration to give thanks for crops and good food

ex.en: People sing and share fresh fruit during the joyful Harvest Festival.
ex.zh: 人们在欢乐的丰收节期间唱歌并分享新鲜的水果。

ex.en: At our school's Harvest Festival, students display pumpkins, corn, and paintings of busy autumn farms.
ex.zh: 在学校的丰收节上，同学们展示南瓜、玉米以及描绘忙碌秋日农场的画作。

col: at the Harvest Festival｜在丰收节上
happy Harvest Festival｜快乐的丰收节
tip: 作为节日名称时两个词首字母都要大写，harvest 意为“收获”。
